target.statement: Likelihood matcher (training-pattern lookup) reaches 99.2 class-weighted accuracy on PATTERN's official test split

compute.basis: Data is public (benchmarking-gnns PATTERN), but the matcher code is unreleased and must be reimplemented from Appendix B: canonical-form subgraph matching plus approximate log-likelihood scoring over 2000 test graphs, CPU-only but non-trivial engineering.

blockers: matcher code not released (available on request only)
approximate log-likelihood scoring details only in appendix, must be re-derived
pattern-blind shortlist component needed for small patterns
title: PATTERN Can Be Solved from Memory: Generator-Aware Baselines for Synthetic Node Classification
